verdict.rationale: SolidJS's core value proposition is fine-grained reactivity compiled into surgical DOM updates—automatic dependency tracking, render-once components, and no virtual DOM diffing—corroborated by hands-on community reports praising its DOM-level performance nearly matching vanilla JS. Missing for 10: no direct first-party technical deep-dive on the compiler's specific code-transform mechanics is included in this pack, only high-level marketing/community statements.
